entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: One of the seven continents of Zendikar, once known for dense jungles and deadly marshes, overrun and destroyed after the release of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which Bala Ged is a continent.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: An ancient empire of which Bala Ged was once a part.

entities.name: Obuun
entities.description: A pre-spirit elf who led the elves of Bala Ged in revolt against their kor rulers.

entities.name: Bala Ged Skyclave
entities.description: A kor skyclave toppled by an elf rebellion, now risen to the sky again.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Zendikari planeswalker who found the Khalni Heart, bested Ob Nixilis, and healed Bala Ged with the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and former planeswalker who hoped to use the Khalni Heart to reignite his spark, and was bested by Nissa.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: An outgrowth of the soul of Zendikar, a huge magical flower hidden in the Guum Wilds.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: A source of healing power that Nissa used on Bala Ged.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titans and their brood whose release overran Bala Ged.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: A warlike nomadic elf tribe of the Tangled Vale who cultivated bloodbriar; many were killed by the titans.

entities.name: Mul Daya
entities.description: Secretive tree-dwelling elves steeped in shamanic rituals and necromancy.

entities.name: Grotag
entities.description: A friendly goblin settlement on the Umung River.

entities.name: Surrakar
entities.description: Reptilian beings that nested in the Guum Wilds.

entities.name: Yarok
entities.description: An elemental horror in Bala Ged corrupted by Ulamog and Kozilek, who retains self-awareness enough to grieve.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose influence corrupted Yarok.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose influence corrupted Yarok.

entities.name: Guum Wilds
entities.description: The humid rain forest that covered most of Bala Ged.

entities.name: Tangled Vale
entities.description: Interconnected jungle valleys in southern Bala Ged where the Joraga lived.

entities.name: Bojuka Bay
entities.description: A giant marsh inside the Guum Wilds at the mouth of the Umung River.

entities.name: Umung River
entities.description: One of the only safe ways to traverse the Guum Wilds.

events.summary: The elves of Bala Ged, led by the pre-spirit Obuun, revolt against their kor rulers and topple their Skyclave.
events.quote: The elves of Bala Ged, led by a pre-spirit Obuun , revolted against their kor rulers and toppled their Skyclave .

events.summary: Within two years of the release of the Eldrazi, Bala Ged is overrun and destroyed.
events.quote: the entire continent of Bala Ged was overrun and destroyed.

events.summary: Nissa Revane finds the Khalni Heart in the devastated continent, defeats Ob Nixilis, and escapes with the Heart.
events.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped.

events.summary: Bala Ged becomes a home of nightmares and horrors and its Skyclave rises again; it slowly recovers after Nissa uses the Lithoform Core.
events.quote: After Nissa Revane 's use of the healing power of the Lithoform Core , the continent slowly recovers.

relations.note: She bested him over the Khalni Heart.
relations.quote: she also ran afoul of the demon Ob Nixilis
Yarok is an elemental horror residing within Bala Ged.
